# PrintHub by C-Chu Media

> PrintHub is the online print ordering portal of C-Chu Media Limited, a printing, branding and publishing company based in Karu, Abuja, Nigeria, operating since 2011. Customers browse the catalogue, configure specifications (size, material, quantity, finishing), see a live price, upload or request a design, pay online and collect or have orders delivered.

## What is offered
- Banners and large-format printing, business cards, stationery, stickers and labels
- Branded souvenirs and promotional items, shirts, uniforms and caps
- Signage, vehicle branding, event and campaign materials
- Book printing and publishing, graphic design, business starter kits

## Practical details
- Prices are in Nigerian Naira and shown on each product page; delivery fees are shown at checkout. Pickup from the Karu office is free.
- Payment: Paystack (card, bank transfer, USSD) or direct bank transfer.
- Location: Suite 38, Mazfallah Shopping Complex, Karu, AMAC 900110, Abuja FCT, Nigeria
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00AM to 7:00PM
- Phone and WhatsApp: +234 805 292 9523
- Email: info@cchumedia.com
